topics.title: What Is Demography?
topics.ncert_sections: What Is Demography?; Don't Miss Out (census)

concepts.learning_objective: Define demography as the study of the size, structure and composition of a population and how it changes over time.
Explain how governments and businesses use demographic information to plan services and allocate resources.
Describe the census as the official count of a country's people and the information it collects.

topics.title: Population at a Glance: India and the World

concepts.learning_objective: Describe the growth of world population since 1950 and the UN projection of its peak and decline.
State India's position as the most populous country and its share of the world population.
Explain how medical advances and better sanitation caused rapid population growth after the 1950s.

topics.title: Birth Rate and Fertility Rate
topics.ncert_sections: What Determines the Population of a Country?; Birth and fertility rates

concepts.learning_objective: Distinguish between birth rate and fertility rate and how each affects population growth.
Explain the replacement level fertility rate of 2.1 and what happens above and below it.
Analyse why fertility rates fall, using China's One-Child Policy and the role of girls' education and urbanisation.
Interpret mortality rate, child mortality and life expectancy as indicators of health and well-being.
Explain the causes of migration and its effects on the areas people move to and from.

topics.title: Stages of Demographic Transition
topics.ncert_sections: How Do Countries Experience Population Change?

concepts.learning_objective: Describe the three stages of demographic transition in terms of birth and death rates.
Relate phases of India's population history to the stages of demographic transition.

topics.title: India's Population: Composition, Sex Ratio and Pyramids
topics.ncert_sections: India's Population: Composition and Trends; Improvement in India's sex ratio

concepts.learning_objective: Define sex ratio and interpret India's sex ratio figures from the Census.
Interpret the shape of a population structure diagram and how India's pyramid has changed since 1950.

topics.title: Demographic Dividend and Population Ageing
topics.ncert_sections: India's Demographic Dividend - A Limited Window of Opportunity

concepts.learning_objective: Explain the demographic dividend and youth bulge and why India's window of opportunity is limited.
Analyse the challenges of an ageing population and the ways nations prepare for it.
